input: Bajaj Auto, held 3+ years for penetration and strong fundamentals in 2 Wheeler segment and strong EV promise. Eternal, bought after the post-IPO dip for Blinkit and Zomato order growth and the platform fee rising.

reasons: penetration and strong fundamentals in 2 Wheeler segment

assumptions.assumption: penetration and strong fundamentals in 2 Wheeler segment
assumptions.reason: September 2026 sales up 5% year-on-year to 538,443 units, but domestic two-wheeler sales fell 12% while exports rose 32%; volume missed Street estimate of 570,000-585,000 units.

sources.title: Bajaj Auto, M&M, Hero Moto skid up to 6%; here's why auto stocks are down
Bajaj Auto September Total Sales At 5,38,443 Units vs 510,504 YoY
